title: DTI UB Holds LLMNetOps Pilot Test with IDREN Partner Universities
summary: Coverage of the LLMNetOps Pilot Test, where DTI UB invited partner universities of IDREN to try the platform and share feedback ahead of the full Workshop Series.

title: UB Receives International Research Funding of USD 30,000 from ISIF Asia for Developing AI System
summary: Universitas Brawijaya received international research funding from ISIF Asia to develop an AI system for strengthening network operations knowledge through locally-hosted generative AI.

title: Universitas Brawijaya Secures US$30,000 Research Funding from ISIF Asia to Develop AI System
summary: Universitas Brawijaya meraih pendanaan riset US$30,000 dari ISIF Asia untuk mengembangkan sistem AI LLMNetOps guna meningkatkan operasional jaringan kampus dan literasi digital.

title: UB Dapat Hibah Riset Internasional untuk Kembangkan Sistem AI Pengelola Jaringan
summary: Universitas Brawijaya menerima hibah riset USD 30,000 dari ISIF Asia untuk mengembangkan LLMNetOps, sistem AI berbasis chatbot yang membantu administrator jaringan di institusi pendidikan Indonesia.

title: LLMNetOps: Strengthening Network Operations Knowledge Through Locally-Hosted Generative AI
summary: The APNIC Foundation project page for LLMNetOps, led by Universitas Brawijaya — aiming to bridge the AI literacy gap by training network professionals to adopt privacy-focused, open-source language models for infrastructure management within IDREN member institutions.
